beats: [d:intrigue][sfx:boom][act:counting them off, intrigued][tune:level]^Hand stencils. [act:quicker][tune:level]^Spirals. [act:quicker still][tune:level]^Zigzags. [act:a playful surprise][tune:risefall]Even ^'handbags'. [act:the scale of it, wide]The same simple signs turn up on ^every inhabited continent.
[d:tension][act:posing the choice, even][tune:rise]Were they handed down from ^one lost source, like a family ^recipe? [act:the alternative, settling][tune:fall]Or invented ^again and again?

[d:calm][act:laying out the facts, calm]Start with ^hands. [p:0.9][act:the number, slow]The oldest dated hand stencil is on an ^Indonesian island: at least ^sixty-seven thousand eight hundred years old. [act:the contrast, lightly]In ^Patagonia, at the far tip of South America, they begin about ^nine thousand years ago. [p:0.93][act:the point, clear]Nearly sixty thousand years apart, on opposite sides of the ^planet.
[d:build][go:4|0][act:building the pattern]In Ice Age Europe, between forty and ten thousand years ago, ^thirty-two signs repeat across ^hundreds of sites.

[d:build][act:presenting his case fairly]The writer Graham Hancock points to a ^'handbag' carved at Göbekli Tepe, at the Olmec site of La Venta, and in the hands of ^Assyrian sages. [p:0.93][act:letting it sink in]Three cultures, thousands of years and an ^ocean apart.
[d:build][sfx:shimmer][act:the big idea, intrigued][tune:rise]A badge of ^one lost tradition, passed from hand to ^hand?

[d:build][act:the turn, explaining with care]But our eyes and brains make certain shapes all by ^themselves: lattices, cobwebs, tunnels, ^spirals. [act:softer, a little wonder]People see them in ^migraines, or on the edge of ^sleep. [p:0.93][act:explaining, a simple picture]Rub your closed eyes, and you may glimpse a few ^yourself. [p:0.93][act:explaining, clear]They come from the wiring of the brain, the ^same in every human ^head.
[d:aside][act:dry, a small smile]And ^every human has hands: the easiest stencil of ^all.

[d:reveal][sfx:hit][act:reasoning it out, clear]One source would leave a ^trail, like ripples from a stone dropped in a ^pond: a first appearance, then a ^spread, with examples in between. [act:the twist, slower][tune:fall]Instead the signs pop up at ^scattered dates, on ^different continents, with no trail between ^them.

[d:build][go:2|0][act:curious, a closer look][tune:rise]And the 'handbags' up ^close@adj? [act:plain, a little amused]In Assyria, it's a ^bucket, for sprinkling purifying ^water. [act:crisp, parallel][tune:fall]^Different objects@noun, different ^jobs.

[d:verdict][p:0.95][act:weighing it, calm authority][tune:rise]One lost ^source for the world's symbols? [act:the verdict, level-headed][tune:fall]*Awaiting ^evidence*. [p:0.93][act:practical, clear]A real trail, dated and connected, would ^change that. [act:the alternative, warmer][tune:rise]One shared human ^brain? [act:simple, confident]That explains ^most of it.
[d:tension][p:0.93][act:gentle, a knowing smile]You don't need a ^lost teacher to draw a spiral. [act:simple, warm, final][tune:fall]You need a ^hand, and an ^eye.
